methodology.anti_lookahead: financial score uses only conservative_known_date <= monthly event date; market regime uses trailing TAIEX data ending at the signal base date
methodology.market_regime_rule: reuse existing trailing 20-trading-day TAIEX regime: strong >= +3%, weak <= -3%, otherwise sideways
methodology.baselines: overall uses all mature events; yearly/industry/regime rows use the corresponding subgroup universe as baseline; exclusion tests use the remaining universe after exclusion
methodology.caution: market regime is descriptive research context only, not a strategy gate
